battle_phases.completion_condition: Steward deploys at frame 2071 with all opening holders alive.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A dead holder or missing conditional grant invalidates the artillery formation.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four interceptions and two sustainable healing lanes.
handoff_requirements: Healing starts before accumulated damage kills its assigned holder.
responsibilities: Fang funds the opening and holds upper center.
Friston holds lower center; Midnight and Melantha close outer routes.
Physicians deploy west while retaining required healing coverage.
survival_dependencies: Fang survives the three budgeted grants.
Friston survives until Ansel begins actual healing.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Artillery is dead and its residual projectiles are resolved without a protected death.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Artillery survival can cause a leak or civilian death even if central containment survives.
battle_phases.goal: Preserve the medical chain and kill artillery before protected-target disaster.
handoff_requirements: No scheduled caster retreat interrupts the damage window.
Central armor receives Steward damage as target priority permits.
responsibilities: Steward attacks artillery on actual range contact.
Both physicians sustain their assigned lanes.
Outer holders continue officer interception and eastern restraint clearance.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward is deployed and eastern artillery contact approaches.
survival_dependencies: Western medicine must survive actual selection and splash.
Steward must survive long enough to deliver lethal damage.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Spawns are exhausted and no hostile enemies remain.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A surviving hostile makes the western clearance rotation unsafe or causes a leak.
battle_phases.goal: Clear all central armor and final runners without saturation.
handoff_requirements: Confirm hostile clearance before both late withdrawals.
responsibilities: Fang and Friston contain queues with physician support.
Midnight and Melantha finish the outer officers.
battle_phases.start_condition: Late armor enters while the established formation remains active.
survival_dependencies: Actual armor damage prevents block overflow.
No outer holder is withdrawn while its route remains active.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both protected targets have arrived alive and all WIN predicates hold.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A stranded or dead civilian fails project acceptance despite possible combat completion.
battle_phases.goal: Release remaining restraints and complete two safe arrivals.
handoff_requirements: Legal redeployment and actual restraint destruction precede final passage.
responsibilities: Steward destroys the western upper restraint after cooldown.
Melantha destroys the western lower restraint after cooldown.
Observe arrivals rather than crediting restraint destruction as arrival.
survival_dependencies: Both civilians survived every prior phase.
No residual projectile threatens their passage.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: No combat allocation to the placeholder route.
Steward supplies checkable arts damage whenever artillery is actually in range. Physicians sustain their corridors. Source death does not remove born projectiles.
Midnight clears eastern upper restraint while intercepting officers; Steward later clears western upper restraint. Ordinary operators never attack or block the civilian.
Melantha clears eastern lower restraint and intercepts officers, then clears western lower restraint after hostiles are gone.
Fang blocks; Hibiscus heals; Steward clears central armor whenever artillery priority permits; Midnight supplies only observed additional damage.
Friston blocks; Ansel heals; continuously deployed Steward supplies armor damage. Three-block capacity does not replace clearance.
Midnight intercepts upper outer enemies with Hibiscus support.
Melantha intercepts lower outer enemies with Ansel support; each officer must die before one-block capacity permits an escape.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-outer interception, eastern restraint and intermittent central damage.
Western lower physician covering Friston and Melantha.
Western upper physician covering Midnight, Fang and Steward.
Continuous eastern-transit artillery damage and central armor clearance.

artillery_budget.decisive_risk: The narrower artillery coverage may be insufficient before western return. Continuous deployment avoids losing later contact to a scheduled retreat, but does not prove lethal damage.
artillery_budget.limitation: Steward [2,6] UP does not cover the entire eastern vertical patrol: [5,7] is outside its discrete range. Transit and northern-wait contact must supply enough real attacks. No 45-hit sequence is asserted.
artillery_budget.reference_sufficient_hit_mix: 36 ordinary Steward hits at 249.10 plus 9 enhanced hits at 473.29 exceed 13000.

economy.qualification: Later costs use the supplied current-model redeployment basis. Death gives no refund. No early deployment depends on a withdrawal.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: Every timeline action is fixed. Assertions are validation gates, not executable conditional commands. Missing prerequisites invalidate continuation; they do not cause automatic rescheduling.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Ansel [5,3] RIGHT includes [4,5] and [6,5]. Hibiscus [2,3] RIGHT includes [1,5], [3,5] and [2,6]. Both physicians cover themselves. These range claims do not establish immunity from artillery selection or splash.

formation_transitions.transition: Establish lower healing at the western platform before the former southern-shell failure window.
Establish upper healing west of Fang and Midnight.
Deploy Steward inside ordinary Hibiscus coverage; retain him through artillery transit and late central armor.
After the asserted hostile clearance, withdraw Steward for western restraint clearance.
Withdraw Melantha after the asserted final lower hostile clearance.
Complete both legal redeployments west and remain until two protected arrivals are observed.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: The seven listed IDs are the complete deployment union; every identity rarity is 1-3 and normal_mode is true.
All deployments use legal terrain and integer [row,col]; never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Fang remains alive for the budgeted grants; all four interceptions close before their enemies pass. A missing grant is a survival or handoff failure.
Ansel must remain available to heal Friston through the former frames 2593-3501 failure chain. Relocation is a hypothesis, not proof of shell avoidance.

Artillery must die before it leaks or kills a protected target; count actual damage and resolve all residual projectiles. Western return is a critical hazard, not a guaranteed deadline inherited from another layout.
Fang's live queue never exceeds two, Friston's never exceeds three, and Melantha's single block must intercept every lower outer enemy.
Skill and retreat actions require a living deployed operator. No death is followed by an assumed refund or free redeployment.
Frames 9000-9001 require no active hostiles and no dangerous residual projectiles. Both returning IDs receive more than 70 seconds of cooldown.

Success requires remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely arrived. Operator deaths are reported independently.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Close all four interceptions, preserve Fang income, and establish both physicians before adding the caster.
Keep Ansel and Friston alive through the former collapse window and accumulate actual artillery damage without a planned caster withdrawal.
Finish artillery before protected-target exposure on western return; clear central armor without losing Fang's two-block capacity.
Kill final armor, runners and outer officers; retain all combat responsibilities until hostile clearance is real.
Complete cooldowns, destroy remaining western restraints and observe both safe arrivals. The horizon is not a success predicate.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic income only while alive and deployed.
Basic attacks and blocking only; no unsupported robot talent.
Eastern restraint and early outer damage, then late central assistance and cleanup. Each repeat follows 40 active seconds plus 70 inactive SP seconds.
Reduce lower interception occupancy and clear restraints; retain blocking throughout.
Strengthen lower sustain across artillery and central pressure; assume one heal target, never the unsupported extra-heal talent.
Begin the first available burst after Steward enters, then sustain upper recipients on legal 50-second cycles.
Automatic enhanced attacks and supported high-defense priority. Measure artillery damage separately from armor and device damage.

tactical_thesis: Move both physicians west of their former artillery exposure and keep Steward continuously deployed at [2,6] UP. Preserve four early interceptions, give Steward ordinary upper medical coverage and access to both central queues, and eliminate the unsupported 70-second caster absence. This changes the survival geometry that produced the verified Ansel-to-Friston collapse. Artillery lethal damage before its western return remains the decisive unverified requirement; this is a complete, unsimulated candidate, not a claimed WIN.
